Subject:

M-A111926-01 Implementation Details of PGRR127, Addition of Proposed Generation to the Planning Models

NOTICE DATE:
 November 19, 2026

NOTICE TYPE:
 M-A111926-01 NPRR/SCR

SHORT DESCRIPTION:
 Implementation Details of PGRR127, Addition of Proposed Generation to the Planning Models

INTENDED AUDIENCE:
  All Market Participants

DAYS AFFECTED:
 December 1, 2026

LONG DESCRIPTION:
 On December 1, 2026, Planning Guide language associated with Planning Guide Revision Request (PGRR) 127, Addition of Proposed Generation to the Planning Models, will be implemented.  

PGRR127 outlines the additional generators that may be included in the planning models to address the generation shortfall introduced by the implementation of the requirement from House Bill (HB) 5066 (88th Legislature), which amended subsection 37.056(c-1) to the Public Utility Regulatory Act (PURA), and Load growth in Texas; and adds a supplemental generation sensitivity analysis for Tier 1 Regional Planning Group (RPG) project evaluation to minimize the impacts of the additional generation on transmission project evaluation.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
 In accordance with Planning Guide Section 1.2.5, Planning Guide Revision Implementation, ERCOT provides notice as soon as practicable but no later than ten days prior to implementation.

PGRR127
 and associated documents can be found on the ERCOT website.
